request.text:
A: Forty years of goblin trade in the ledgers, and we ended it in a morning. I'm writing that down.
<long pause>
A: The clan keeps songs older than my oldest page. I've begged for a copy. Twice.
<long pause>
A: You found it. The ember. May I... no. No, don't hand it to me. I'd only want to know what it costs.
<long pause>
A: I've written down the bridge. All of it. Someone should, while we still remember it right.
<long pause>
A: Mother Skarrow's people remember things my ledgers don't. If you go up the hill again, ask them about the seven. Please.
<long pause>
B: <young, tired, dry working voice Mood: sad.> The watch says the goblins scattered when their old woman fell. Scattered where, in this cold?
<long pause>
B: <young, tired, dry working voice Mood: idle.> Carried my first sack up the goblin path today. The little ones watched me the whole way.
<long pause>
B: <young, tired, dry working voice Mood: idle.> Ground under the docks went cold as a grave. Nobody's saying why.
<long pause>
B: <young, tired, dry working voice Mood: idle.> Hands are cold, but they still work. That's something.
